articles.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Nifty futures hint at a positive start as index aims 5th day of gains
articles.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Its been a while since we wrote this at the start of the day, but going into today's Nifty weekly expiry, global cues, barring the AI rally overnight, seem favourable for the bulls. Crude prices are cooling, Brent is on the verge of slipping below $100, bond yields have cooled off as well and there has been no news of any new attacks in West Asia at least as of now. The Nifty goes into today's session on the back of four straight days of gains, and also after managing to close above the 23,400 mark, a level it found regular resistance through last week.
articles.content:
Following an initially subdued opening, the benchmark indices demonstrated resilience throughout the trading session, with purchasing interest maintaining a slight edge for the majority of the period.
